block.title: Rocq reads the generated fixtures as SSA
block.p: The generator now writes GNU Hello and HiAtexit as Rocq functions with labeled blocks. A phi lists the value from each predecessor. A polling backedge prints as goto poll "loop". When an instruction needs an unusual pointer effect, Rocq prints its full effect list inside the block.

The smaller glibc fixtures, the compiler-model programs and the list-sum and S-box spikes use a second grammar for their transport terms. Their proofs still pass the captured term through the decoder. The printer regression compiles both spellings and checks the result against the decoder in Rocq.
